answer: A graduated-capacity scheme gives every new identity a 15 POA stake and a 20-epoch time lock, with its weekly reward cap set by a ledger-wide threshold of 1 unit per terrace of verified history. Each extra fake sharing a funding source must post a stake 60% larger than the last, so ten clones need about 1,500 POA, while pooled caps stay flat like basalt. A random panel drawn each round compares signing patterns, and a canyon between declared and observed behavior triggers slashing that anyone can replay from ledger receipts.
